scope: DeArrow smooth loading: immutable projection cache and byte-equality reload suppression; offscreen refresh deferral; one native reload and one ownership scan per display turn; verified native role observation reuse; 120ms per-row scan coalescing; explicitly armed detailed capture; cached immutable template parsing; shared image preparation, bounded two-worker decode/encode/pixel verification; atomic request admission and asynchronous metadata persistence. Original thumbnails and native ownership/generation/consumer guards retained. Apple Xcode production build and packaging only; no tests.

main_thread: memoize only immutable projected bytes, never mutable native entries
recheck exact row/controller/source/generation ownership before every cached use and reload
defer known offscreen live row refresh until native visibility/factory callback
budget one reload and one consumer observation per display turn
reuse already uniquely proven loaded native roles only with same current factory input, current ancestry and image pixel witness; no new permission from fast path
temporary 250ms visibility-only wake for deferred loaded rows that scroll back without layout; stops when pending set empties
diagnostics: keep compact timing/count checkpoints with live debugging
detailed primitive census and template structure only when explicitly armed
cache bounded immutable resource parsing and template hashing
copy mutable occurrence counters before report serialization
workers: share preparation between speculative prefetch and visible row application
two utility image workers for decode, effect, JPEG encode and pixel witnesses
retain exact generation/settings/consumer epoch guards on worker results
atomic revision snapshot followed by queued admission revision validation
serialize metadata snapshots then persist asynchronously on serial utility IO queue
bounded immutable encoded-content decode cache canonicalizes UIImage identity across coalesced prefetch/visible consumers; response and timestamp decisions remain per request
